Name: Image Chip B
Description: The Image Chip  B (ICHIPB) TRE is a system independent NITF TRE that holds the support data needed for the mensuration of (non-warped) SDE-based image chips.

XFRM_FLAG.Name: Non-linear Transformation Flag
XFRM_FLAG.Description: This field contains the non-linear transformation flag.

SCALE_FACTOR.Name: Scale Factor
SCALE_FACTOR.Description: This field contains the scale factor relative to R0 (original full image resolution). Typically reciprocal of display magnification.

ANAMRPH_CORR.Name: Anamorphic Correction Indicator
ANAMRPH_CORR.Description: This field indicates whether or not anamorphic correction has been applied.

SCANBLK_NUM.Name: Scan Block Number
SCANBLK_NUM.Description: This field contains the scan block index number. 00 is used if not applicable.

OP_ROW_11.Name: Output product row number component of grid point index (1,1)
OP_ROW_11.Description: This field contains the output product row number component of grid point index (1,1) for intelligent data.

OP_COL_11.Name: Output product column number component of grid point index (1,1)
OP_COL_11.Description: This field contains the output product column number component of grid point index (1,1) for intelligent data.

OP_ROW_12.Description: This field contains the output product row number component of grid point index (1,2) for intelligent data.

OP_COL_12.Name: Output product column number component of grid point index (1,2)
OP_COL_12.Description: This field contains the output product column number component of grid point index (1,2) for intelligent data.

OP_ROW_21.Name: Output product row number component of grid point index (2,1)
OP_ROW_21.Description: This field contains the output product row number component of grid point index (2,1) for intelligent data.

OP_COL_21.Name: Output product column number component of grid point index (2,1)
OP_COL_21.Description: This field contains the output product column number component of grid point index (2,1) for intelligent data.

OP_ROW_22.Name: Output product row number component of grid point index (2,2)
OP_ROW_22.Description: This field contains the output product row number component of grid point index (2,2) for intelligent data.

OP_COL_22.Name: Output product column number component of grid point index (2,2)
OP_COL_22.Description: This field contains the output product column number component of grid point index (2,2) for intelligent data.

FI_ROW_11.Name: Grid point (1,1) row number in full image coordinate system
FI_ROW_11.Description: This field contains the Grid point (1,1), row number in full image coordinate system.

FI_COL_11.Name: Grid point (1,1) column number in full image coordinate system
FI_COL_11.Description: This field contains the Grid point (1,1) column number in full image coordinate system.

FI_ROW_12.Description: This field contains the Grid point (1,2), row number in full image coordinate system.

FI_COL_12.Description: This field contains the Grid point (1,2) column number in full image coordinate system.

FI_ROW_21.Description: This field contains the Grid point (2,1), row number in full image coordinate system.

FI_COL_22.Name: Grid point (2,2) column number in full image coordinate system
FI_COL_22.Description: This field contains the Grid point (2,2) column number in full image coordinate system.

FI_ROW.Name: Full Image Number of Rows
FI_ROW.Description: This field contains the number of rows in a full image.

FI_COL.Name: Full Image Number of Columns
FI_COL.Description: This field contains the number of columns in a full image.
